title: Scientist X lecture at University of Denver

tellings.quote: On March 8th, 1950, Newton took the stage as [music] the mysterious scientist X.

plain: On March 8, 1950, a man named Silas Newton stood up at the University of Denver in Colorado and gave a lecture as the mysterious "Scientist X." Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, in an episode about a crash in which sixteen alien bodies are said to have been found. In that episode the lecture is part of how the crashed craft story first reached the public.
